_comment: Sources checked every week. type=rss reads a news feed; type=page reads links from a news page. keyword_filter=true keeps only items matching keywords.json; false keeps everything (the whole source is relevant).
_note: The Interior Ministry and ameli news pages are behind Cloudflare bot checks that block GitHub's servers, so they are linked on the page for manual checking instead (see render.py, ALSO_CHECK).
